assertion_results.text: Recommends NOT using a real SMTP server for the primary unit tests
assertion_results.evidence: Says: "For testing a welcome-email function, I usually do not start with a real SMTP server" and "Unit test: mock the email sender (most tests)."

assertion_results.text: Asserts on what was sent (recipient/content/calls) via a mock or spy
assertion_results.evidence: Says: "verify sendWelcomeEmail was called with correct data" and later lists fake SMTP assertions including "recipient" and "HTML/text body."

assertion_results.text: Suggests isolating side effect from logic so the core decision can be tested purely
assertion_results.evidence: Says: "You’re testing your application logic, not whether SMTP works" and recommends an "EmailSender" abstraction so "your signup code never cares whether the email is real or fake."
